context: batch s159 (Psych Pharmacology B1) builds three new class cards in the Psychiatry Medications section: pc-maoi (MAOIs), pc-snri (SNRIs) and pc-antidep (Other antidepressants: bupropion, mirtazapine, trazodone, vilazodone, vortioxetine); antidep-other retires into them (its 8 bank items move with ids unchanged). A class card has no decision spine: RULES.md in each folder gives the card rules (CARD_SPEC.md). This is review round 1, on each whole card

types.pc-maoi: class card "MAOIs" (phenelzine, tranylcypromine, isocarboxazid, selegiline patch), ported by the lead from mockup v3; owns the MAOI washout windows, tyramine hypertensive crisis and MAOI interactions; has a washout timeline chart; review in full
types.pc-snri: class card "SNRIs" (venlafaxine, desvenlafaxine, duloxetine, levomilnacipran, milnacipran); owns SNRI uses, dose-dependent hypertension and the venlafaxine false-positive PCP screen; the discontinuation window is owned by ssri-effects and the MAOI washout by pc-maoi (pointers only); review in full
types.pc-antidep: class card "Other antidepressants" (bupropion, mirtazapine, trazodone, vilazodone, vortioxetine); owns bupropion seizure risk and contraindications, mirtazapine and trazodone uses, ischemic priapism with trazodone; review in full

acc: Where a board source (AnKing card, UWorld, NBME) and a guideline or label differ, the card teaches the board answer and puts the other in an "In practice:" hover: the hover is intended, not a finding.
Word counts are not judged (2026-10-19 layers rule: nothing is cut for length).

Trade names appear only with a current DailyMed label (CARD_SPEC section 4). Lead calls: Cymbalta is left out (DailyMed by name returns only repackager labels, newest 2016); Desyrel and Zyban are left out (no current label). Their absence is not a finding.

Lead calls (judge accuracy, not the choice): vilazodone and vortioxetine (pc-antidep) and levomilnacipran and milnacipran (pc-snri) are added to the subtitles from AnKing cards; pc-snri and pc-antidep have no timeline chart (the discontinuation window is owned by ssri-effects; the 4-hour priapism threshold sits in the pc-antidep danger row only).

pc-maoi lint hedges answered by the lead (not findings unless the line now overstates its quote): S079 and S090 drop "may" from the Nardil label's "occipital headache which may radiate frontally" (the may qualifies the spread, which the card does not state); S085 and S093 drop "typically" from MSD's serotonin syndrome feature list (recognition lists); S077 lists abrupt-stop features framed as possible.
The 8 bank items moved from antidep-other are verbatim with ids unchanged; judge their accuracy like any line.
Audit cards_disposition.json against cards.md: every covered entry must name claim ids that teach the card.
read: A class card has no decision spine: judge it by RULES.md (the card layout), not by spine step structure. Pause point labels, "Where the choice is made" and "Practice" are site conventions.
Not to report: card length or word count (2026-10-19 layers rule).
drawer_targets.txt lists in-page anchors as MISSING when they are section anchors, not broken brief links.
antidep-other is retired in this batch (its title is an alias span on the page); a pointer to it would be a finding, its absence is not.

Lead calls (do not report the choice; judge wording): Cymbalta, Desyrel and Zyban have no trade name on the cards (no current label); no timeline chart on pc-snri or pc-antidep; serotonin syndrome management stays in ssri-effects (pointer only).
flags: line_sources.txt cuts each quote at 600 characters (a known packet limit); facts.json in the same folder holds every quote whole. Before reporting that a quote does not support a line, Grep facts.json for the fact id.
Word counts are not judged (2026-10-19 layers rule).

Builder and lead lint answers (not findings unless the line now overstates its quote): pc-maoi S079, S090 ("may" on the headache's spread), S085, S093 ("typically" on recognition lists), S077 (abrupt-stop features as possible); pc-antidep 4 card_dispositions soft warnings covered in other words and the owners pointer hedge; pc-snri restored its "may", "Typically" and "often" hedges.
cuts.json, where present, records content removed because no board source supported it; a cut is not a finding.

acc: Check specifically (pc-snri, report item): the moved item q_6c2aed51ed02f9dc133a and the card's discontinuation note teach restart the drug, then a slow taper (analogy to the AnKing paroxetine card), while ssri-effects teaches reassurance first, then consider a restart with a slow taper (NBME psych-cms8-3b2f19 calls most cases self-limited). Judge which order the board sources support for venlafaxine, and give the replacement wording if the card should change.

Check specifically: doses, washout intervals (2 weeks off most antidepressants before an MAOI, 5 weeks off fluoxetine; 2 weeks off an MAOI before another serotonergic drug), contraindications (bupropion with a seizure disorder, bulimia or anorexia, or an abrupt stop of alcohol or sedatives) and every next step.
read: Check specifically: ownership seams. pc-maoi against mdd, ssri-effects, toxidrome and parkinson (selegiline); pc-snri against ssri-effects (discontinuation, serotonin syndrome), backpain, panic and substance (urine screen); pc-antidep against ssri-effects (sexual dysfunction switch), sud-meds (bupropion for smoking), peds-sleep and mdd. Report a line that re-teaches an owned decision, or a pointer whose target does not own it.
